title: The Last Vector
author: Coral Brightwater
blurb: Ansel Underhill, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
